payload.title: Console reconnect of a Gen2 app deletes branch backend stacks (Anthus CMS outage 2026-10-19)
payload.description: Timeline (UTC, 2026-10-19): Ryan reconnected Amplify app d7s858igkyct5 (anth-us-cms) to AnthusAI/Anth.us-web in the console. The reconnect deleted the main and staging branches; Amplify then deleted the main branch backend stack amplify-d7s858igkyct5-main-branch-1ab9171f70 from 17:30Z (data: AppSync API and 39 DynamoDB tables with the 131-item CMS; reprojectondeploy; knowledgevectors). s3projection failed to delete because the CloudFront KeyValueStore is used by the live edge function papyrus-edge-anth-us-viewer-request (the site bucket is Retain), but its bucket policy had already been deleted, which took anth.us down; the identical policy was restored out of band. storage (media bucket) and auth (Cognito pool) still exist; parent is DELETE_FAILED with termination protection ON. Branches main and staging recreated with env vars restored; backend.stackArn is empty. No DynamoDB backups, PITR or AWS Backup points exist. Findings: KVS name is deterministic so a rebuild collides; main papyrus.config.ts has placeholder edgeDistributionArn. Recovery plan: /Users/home/Projects/anthus-backend-rebuild-runbook.md. Protective steps for the other Gen2 apps are in section 5 of the runbook.
